args:
cd /workspace
set +e
python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --require-hashes \
  -r jobs/intelligence-mart/requirements-bigquery-probe.lock \
  > /workspace/b3-canary.log 2>&1
rc=$?
if [[ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]]; then
  python scripts/gcp/b3-screening-canary.py --output /workspace/b3-canary.json \
    >> /workspace/b3-canary.log 2>&1
  rc=$?
fi
echo "${rc}" > /workspace/b3-canary.rc
if [[ ! -s /workspace/b3-canary.json ]]; then
  python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
log = Path("/workspace/b3-canary.log").read_text(errors="replace")[-12000:]
Path("/workspace/b3-canary.json").write_text(
    json.dumps({"status":"failed","error":log}, indent=2) + "\n"
)
PY
fi
exit 0
